verdict.rationale: Bland documents dedicated, isolated infrastructure for enterprise customers, but that infrastructure is provisioned and run by Bland. Nothing in the pack shows open-source runtime code or a self-hosting path, so this is an adjacent capability only. A community post asking for an open-source alternative 'that I can run on my own' suggests Bland itself is not self-hostable.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure
